info.name: AQDI Admin API
info.description:
Complete Admin API under /api/admin.

1. Import AQDI-Admin-API.postman_environment.json
2. Set baseUrl
3. Run Employee login, copy data.token to employee_token

request.description: Auto-saves token to employee_token on success.
Send only fields to change. All contract columns optional except id, uuid, timestamps.
